speaker: charlie
text: Right, sports fans, let's talk about dominance! The Oklahoma City Thunder are sitting pretty at 5-0 in the NBA playoffs, absolutely rolling through their opponents. Last night they thumped the Lakers 108-90 in Game 1 of their second round series, and they did it without star forward Jalen Williams who's been out with a hamstring injury.

speaker: alice
text: That's what you call a complete team performance! Even when reigning MVP Shai Gilgeous-Alexander had arguably his worst game of the season - first time he failed to score 20 points since last year's playoffs - they still cruised to victory. Chet Holmgren stepped up with 24 points to lead the charge.

speaker: charlie
text: It shows the depth they've built over there in Oklahoma City. And speaking of feel-good stories, congratulations to Oakland Athletics catcher Shea Langeliers and his wife Reagan who welcomed their first son yesterday morning! Nothing quite beats becoming a parent - that's a championship that beats any trophy. The A's family is growing both on and off the field!
